description: Scrape cryptocurrency rankings, trending coins, NFTs and categories, search results, and full coin profiles from CoinGecko's free public API. No API key, account or cookie is required.

category.description: Only return coins in this CoinGecko category (mode=markets), e.g. decentralized-finance-defi, layer-1, stablecoins. Run mode=categories to discover slugs. Legacy `categoryId` is accepted.
category.title: Category filter

categoryOrder.description: How mode=categories sorts the category directory. Legacy `catOrder` is accepted.
categoryOrder.title: Category order

coinIds.description: CoinGecko IDs (bitcoin, ethereum) or full coingecko.com coin URLs. Used by mode=byId for full profiles, and by mode=markets to restrict rankings to these coins. Legacy `coinId` and `ids` are accepted.
coinIds.title: Coin IDs or URLs

includeSparkline.description: Add the raw 168-hour price series (sparklineIn7d) to each ranking record. Off keeps records small.
includeSparkline.title: Include 7-day sparkline

maxItems.description: Maximum records to return. Rankings page through CoinGecko 250 at a time, so values above 250 cost extra requests and may wait on the public rate limit. Legacy `limit` is accepted.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMarketCap.description: Drop coins whose market cap is above this value in the chosen quote currency (mode=markets).
maxMarketCap.title: Maximum market cap

maxRank.description: Drop coins ranked below this number, e.g. 500 to stop at rank 500 (mode=markets).
maxRank.title: Maximum market cap rank

maxVolume24h.description: Drop coins whose 24-hour trading volume is above this value (mode=markets).
maxVolume24h.title: Maximum 24h volume

minMarketCap.description: Drop coins whose market cap is below this value in the chosen quote currency (mode=markets).
minMarketCap.title: Minimum market cap

minRank.description: Drop coins ranked above this number, e.g. 101 to skip the top 100 (mode=markets).
minRank.title: Minimum market cap rank

minVolume24h.description: Drop coins whose 24-hour trading volume is below this value (mode=markets). Legacy `min24hVolume` is accepted.
minVolume24h.title: Minimum 24h volume

mode.description: Choose what to collect: ranked market data, matching coins, one or more full coin profiles, the current trending list, or the category directory. Older `coins`/`rankings` values are mapped in code, but this form validates the five current modes.
enumTitles: Rankings — coins ordered by market cap or volume
Search — find coins by name or symbol
Coin profiles — full data for specific coin IDs or URLs
Trending — top coins, NFTs, categories and RWAs right now
Categories — every CoinGecko category with stats
mode.title: Mode

order.description: How mode=markets sorts coins. Legacy `sort` and `orderBy` are accepted.
order.title: Ranking order

searchQuery.description: Coin name or symbol to search for (mode=search). Example: bitcoin, sol, doge. Legacy key `query` is also accepted.
searchQuery.title: Search query

startPage.description: First 250-coin page to read in mode=markets. Use it to resume a deep ranking after CoinGecko's rate limit. Legacy `page` is accepted.
startPage.title: Starting page

vsCurrency.description: Currency used for every price field. All 63 currencies supported by CoinGecko's public API are listed. Legacy `currency` and `quoteCurrency` are accepted.
vsCurrency.title: Quote currency

title: CoinGecko Scraper Input
